inventory_scope.alias_scope: Union of existing calibration inventory images and LOCAL_IMAGE_ATTESTATION_CATALOG paths; no claim of a new exhaustive filesystem scan.

crc_comparison.algorithm: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC: reflected0xEDB88320, init/xoroutFFFFFFFF, standard zlib.crc32 byte order; host-side computation only.

historical_log.limitation: Original historical log is not reverified if absent; retained historical reports supply the CRC table and line-numbered operation extracts.

crc_comparison.authority: Historical corroboration only; authoritative comparison input is current.preserved.bin.

limits: Current input authority comes from the supplied preserved physical input, not file naming, date or historical CRC matching.
This comparison proves byte identity of files; it does not establish untouched subsequent vehicle state or independently validate acquisition method.
Historical CRC32 agreement is corroboration and is not cryptographic identity.
